name: Yew

profile.Languages: English, French, Latin, Malay, Chinese, Tamil
profile.Civilian Appearance: A distinguished man who appears to be in his early forties. Dark brown hair with subtle grey streaks, pale skin and muted grey-green eyes. Usually wears tailored shirts, waistcoats and long coats. His posture is composed, and his expressions rarely reveal his true intentions.
profile.Guardian Appearance:
Blightyou - Dark green and black Guardian attire with silver detailing resembling yew branches. His costume has a formal, sophisticated appearance rather than heavy armour. His dark yew-berry ring remains visible. When using his powers, poisonous vines and roots emerge around him.
Luma Yew - White base
profile.Original Element: Fire — permanently active to neutralise the poison within his body, leaving him unable to consciously manipulate Fire.
profile.Inherited Element: Earth — inherited from Luma Venom; poisonous in nature.
profile.Transformation Item: Ring decorated with a dark yew berry
profile.Signature Ability: Manipulates poisonous Earth-based vegetation, including toxic roots, vines and thorns. His Fire Core continuously burns away the poison spreading through his own body, allowing him to survive his otherwise dangerous inheritance.
profile.Strengths: Exceptional strategic intelligence, extensive knowledge of Guardian power and Star Cores, Shadow techniques, poisonous vegetation manipulation, long-term planning, deception and information manipulation. His experience and administrative access allow him to anticipate Guardian operations and conceal suspicious activity.
profile.Weaknesses: His Fire Core is permanently occupied with neutralising the poison produced by his inherited Earth power. Although his Fire Core remains active and functional, it cannot spare enough energy for conscious Fire manipulation. If its activity is suppressed or disrupted, the poison will begin spreading through his body, potentially killing him. Deuteranopia (red-green colour blindness).
profile.Fear: Losing the protection of his Fire Core and succumbing to the poison within his body.
profile.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Cedar *(deceased)* and Luma Venom are unofficial mentors.
profile.Likes: Strategic planning, studying Guardian powers, acquiring knowledge, maintaining control over situations.
profile.Dislikes: Unpredictability, restrictions on Guardian power, interference with his research.
profile.Hates: The limitations imposed by the existing Guardian system.
profile.Personality: Cassian is intelligent, patient, calculating and highly observant. He presents himself as a reliable and experienced Guardian who values discipline, efficiency and the protection of others. Beneath this respectable image, he is deeply manipulative and willing to sacrifice others for his ambitions. He rarely acts impulsively, preferring to establish trust, study his targets and arrange circumstances in his favour. He believes that concentrating Guardian power into a single perfect Star Core would eliminate the limitations and weaknesses of the current system.
Personality Example: When a mission goes wrong, Yew remains composed and offers practical solutions, even when he secretly arranged the circumstances that caused the failure.
When questioned about a suspicious incident, he calmly provides records, witness accounts and logical explanations that direct attention away from himself.
profile.Core Idea of character: A highly respected Guardian strategist secretly operating as Blightyou. Awakened by Luma Venom, he inherited poisonous Earth powers that would have killed him if not for his original Fire Core continuously burning away the poison. Although Fire sustains his life, he cannot control it. Obsessed with overcoming the limitations of Guardian power, he attempts to acquire all four elements and create a perfect, unrestricted Star Core, regardless of the lives sacrificed.
Quotes: “Survival is not proof of strength. It is proof that something remains unfinished.”
“The system was built to protect us. That does not mean it was built correctly.”*“Why entrust fragments of power to hundreds when one Guardian could command it all?”*
profile.Background:
In 1795, at age 40, he lost his parents during a monster attack and was emergency-awakened by Luma Venom.
However, the Earth power inherited from Venom was poisonous to his body. His original Fire Core continuously burned away the poison to keep him alive. As its entire capacity was occupied with neutralising the poison, Cassian could only consciously manipulate Earth, primarily through poisonous vegetation.
Cassian later trained under Luma Ophiuchus, mastering Shadow techniques. Concerned about his condition, Venom introduced him to Luma Cedar, a Support Guardian specialising in Star Core research. Cedar took Cassian under his wing, hoping to stabilise his condition and eventually allow him to control Fire.
Under Cedar's guidance, Cassian gained extensive knowledge of Star Cores, elemental inheritance and power extraction. Impressed by his abilities, Cedar recommended him for responsibilities within the Command System, granting him access to sensitive Guardian records and mission information.
Over time, Cassian became obsessed with overcoming the limitations of Guardian powers. During a monster attack, he deliberately allowed Cedar to be mortally wounded and secretly extracted a fragment of his power. He concealed his betrayal and portrayed Cedar's death as a heroic sacrifice.
Cassian subsequently changed his official zodiac registration from Sagittarius to Capricorn, supposedly to honour Cedar, while falsifying records to conceal his past and elemental origins.
Under the secret identity Blightyou, he began conducting forbidden experiments using monsters and artefacts to extract Guardian powers. His ultimate goal is to obtain all four elements and create a perfect, unrestricted Star Core.
To this day, Luma Yew remains a respected Guardian strategist, with neither his betrayal nor his identity as Blightyou publicly known.
